title: Three Goals Down at Home. 370 People Watching. Then This.
description:
On 7 March 2024 Olympiacos lost 1–4 at home to Maccabi Tel Aviv in the Europa Conference League round of 16. Three days later they lost the derby to Panathinaikos. One week after the first leg, in an almost empty ground in Bačka Topola, Serbia — 370 people, on José Luis Mendilibar's 63rd birthday — they won 6–1 after extra time and went through 7–5. It is still the biggest away win in the club's European history, and eleven weeks later Olympiacos won the competition.

This film tells both nights from the stands: every goal, the words of Mendilibar, Robbie Keane and Eran Zahavi as they were printed, and what the papers wrote the morning after.

Every score, date and quote on screen is printed from FanLife's archive (UEFA match records) and the sources listed below.
